description: This Swift source file defines the MenuContextCardInjector class, which injects a custom context menu card into an NSMenu within a macOS application. It manages cache refreshes, dynamically inserts views into menus, and handles menu lifecycle events to provide session information within a menu context.

classes.name: MenuContextCardInjector
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for injecting a custom session context card into macOS menu items, managing cache loading, menu item insertion, and menu lifecycle events.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Sets up the injector into a given NSStatusItem, attaching itself as the menu delegate and warming cache.

methods.name: menuWillOpen
methods.description: Handles the event when the menu is about to open; injects the custom view into the menu.

methods.name: menuDidClose
methods.description: Handles the event when the menu closes; cancels ongoing tasks.

methods.name: menuNeedsUpdate
methods.description: Proxy for the delegate method to handle menu updates.

methods.name: confinementRect
methods.description: Provides the rectangle within which the menu should confine its display.

methods.name: refreshCache
methods.description: Asynchronously loads and updates the session rows cache, handling errors.

methods.name: cachedView
methods.description: Generates an AnyView representing the current cache state for display.

methods.name: loadCurrentRows
methods.description: Loads current session rows asynchronously, filtering and sorting them.

methods.name: findInsertIndex
methods.description: Determines the index at which to insert the custom card in the menu.

methods.name: initialCardWidth
methods.description: Calculates an appropriate initial width for the injected card view.

methods.name: captureMenuWidthIfAvailable
methods.description: Records the menu’s width for consistent sizing of injected views.
